title: Residential Electricity Supply: Compensation Multiplier for Restored Dual-Fuel Credits
content:
**Rule.** When a missed dual-fuel credit is restored on a Residential Electricity Supply agreement, the per-cycle dual-fuel credit, together with any uplift added to it, is multiplied by a compensation multiplier set by how many dual-fuel credit lines the agreement already carries for recent cycles.

**What is counted.** The dual-fuel credit lines on the agreement whose billing cycle started less than twelve whole months before the restoration date. A cycle start counts when fewer than 12 whole months separate it from the restoration date; a cycle that started exactly 12 whole months earlier, or more, is not counted.

| Dual-fuel credit lines counted | Compensation multiplier |
|---|---|
| 10 or more | 1.5 (established-bundle factor) |
| 6 to 9 | 1.25 (developing-bundle factor) |
| fewer than 6 | 1, the amount is taken as it stands |

## Boundaries

- 10 lines takes 1.5; 9 lines takes 1.25.
- 6 lines takes 1.25; 5 lines takes 1.

## Counting window (hypothetical restoration date 2026-03-14)

| Billing cycle start of a dual-fuel credit line | Whole months before 2026-03-14 | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 2025-03-15 | 11 | yes |
| 2025-03-14 | 12 | no |
| 2025-09-02 | 6 | yes |

## Example (hypothetical)

A per-cycle credit of 3.00 USD with no uplift, on an agreement carrying 7 counted lines, becomes 3.00 USD multiplied by 1.25, which is 3.75 USD.
